I've saved the Q3 answers to `answer.json`, but I haven't checked them against your Q2 reference values. The project's CLAUDE.md says not to check results against reference values and to submit the first result directly, so I didn't run the same queries for Q2.

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| a. Top segment by net sales | consumer, 362,515,070원 |
| b. Customers with a paid order | 295 |
| c. Top category by net sales | svc, 356,197,328원 |
| d. Month with the highest net sales | 2025-09 |
| e. Customer with the largest total refunds | u140@ex.com (1,869,650원) |
| f. Customers with 2 or more paid orders | 280 |
| g. Average net sales per order | 663,927원 |
| h. September growth over August | 10.4% (265,195,719 → 292,830,601) |

Choices I made where the definitions left room:
- **Segment names:** the data mixes case and has stray spaces (`'smb'`, `' consumer'`, `'Enterprise '`). I trimmed them and lowercased them before grouping.
- **Quarter boundary:** order times are all in UTC with a `Z` suffix. I used July 1 up to (not including) October 1, by UTC date.
- **Average per order (g):** I divided by the number of paid orders in the quarter.

To check this, run the same queries for Q2 and compare them with your reference values.
